== Description ==

[[Joe Olson]] (left) and [[Greg Shaw]] (right) in the Final Confrontation at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, watched by [[Steve Harpster]] (standing left, black jacket and glasses) and [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (seated centre, black Mariners cap and black jacket).
